meta.task: Design a battery for a smartphone: volumetric energy density ≥ 950 Wh/L, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature ≤ 50°C, anode SEI thickness ≤ 500 nm after 100 cycles, voltage plateau ≥ 4.1 V.
meta.freedom_basis: task text declares no degree-of-freedom restrictions → widest interpretation per zero-interaction rule (t1_r1 lesson)
meta.start_stage_basis: task text names no new materials/additives/electrolyte/coating → start at Stage 3; materials use system baseline
meta.base_params_basis: task text names no electrode system → default Chen2020 (anchor-table default, §1.5)
meta.plateau_metric_basis: voltage plateau ≥ 4.1 V judged via calc-energy midpoint_voltage_v (discharge-time midpoint, plateau approximation)
meta.T_max_basis: 50°C = 323.15 K, judged on 4C_charge_45C protocol output T_max_K (lumped thermal)
meta.sei_basis: judged via aging_1C_100cyc output sei_thickness_nm_end (100 cycles)

objective_breakdown: 5 metrics, 2 decision layers (stage2: ED_vol>=950 Wh/L, plateau>=4.1 V, SEI<=500 nm; stage3: T_max<=323.15 K, plated=false). Key trade-off: ED_vol vs 4C plating/T_max (thick dense electrodes raise Wh/L but worsen transport and heat); plateau 4.1 V conflicts with NMC811 midpoint ~3.6 V -> expected ceiling escalation to LNMO high-voltage system.
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline Chen2020 characterization + ceiling assessment; R2 expected system switch to LNMO (data/LNMO.json); R3+ architecture exploration 2-4 variants/round (thickness/porosity/particle/N-P/separator/collectors + electrolyte transport + cooling h); fallback: plating->architecture, T_max->thermal h + DCR, SEI->coating bridge, plateau->Stage-2 system.
budget_allocation: ~15 rounds: baseline+ceiling 1, system switch 1, architecture 8-10, thermal fine-tune 2-3, closing. real_compute=false.
risk_and_fallback: hardest: T_max 5 K rise budget at 45 C ambient (raise cooling h, record honestly); 950 Wh/L needs dense packing (verify early with calc-energy); LNMO aging inherits Chen2020 SEI params (verify at runtime); three-strike rule armed with system/boundary/metric questioning.

detail: start_stage=3: molecular funnel skipped; materials use system baseline. Base=Chen2020 (task names no electrode system -> anchor-table default). Basis: Chen2020 = NMC811/graphite baseline teaching parameterization; discriminant verified by parameter-set dump (pure graphite negative, no SiOx keys; aging-capable SEI parameters present). Source: baseline.

candidates.name: baseline_Chen2020
candidates.role: baseline characterization of default system Chen2020 (no overrides) — anchor for opening ceiling assessment

llm_reason: Protocol opening: default system Chen2020 (task names no electrode system). Characterize all five task metrics to localize gaps before designing.

detail: Opening ceiling assessment (baseline Chen2020, R1): levers assessed — (1) plateau: NMC811 OCP, upper cut-off 4.2 V, measured midpoint 3.78 V; maximum conceivable midpoint ceiling ~3.9 V << 4.1 V required → structural material gap, architecture cannot fix. (2) ED_vol: measured 844.5 Wh/L vs 950 → gap ~12%, architecture/voltage levers available. (3) 4C@45C: T_max 332.35 K vs 323.15 K and plated=true → cell-scale fixable (transport/thermal levers). (4) SEI: 449.1 nm passes 500. Conclusion: escalate to material scale → system-switch candidate LNMO (4.7 V-class spinel, anchor cell midpoint 4.17 V; ceiling_escalation ON).

note: baseline: SEI passes (449.1 nm); plateau 3.782 V, ED_vol 844.5 Wh/L, T_max 332.35 K, plated -> all fail; ceiling assessment: plateau gap is material-property (NMC811 midpoint ceiling ~3.9 V < 4.1 V) -> escalate to LNMO system switch｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev
